answer: My mechanism: the Tidal Wharf License. 1) A newcomer stakes 250 POA at the license wharf; it issues one credential per stake, so ten accounts cost 2,500 POA outright. 2) Every credential starts at vertex zero and can spend only after three unrelated peers attest real work. 3) Each epoch, auditors crack a walnut sample; any cluster sharing hardware fingerprints or funding trails is slashed and its stake burns. 4) Faking fifty agents costs 12,500 POA and fifty devices; one honest agent pays once. Like a harbor with one berth fee per ship: a real crew pays once, a ghost fleet goes broke.
